sit.steps: Deploy infrastructure using Bicep templates. Validate resource deployment, connectivity, and configuration against expected outputs.
sit.outcome: All required Azure resources are successfully deployed and operational.

at.steps: Generate RMF artifacts from normalized JSON data and verify content generation and template population.
at.outcome: Required RMF artifacts are generated successfully with complete and traceable content.

ot.steps: Execute end-to-end artifact generation process using production-like configuration data and review outputs.
ot.outcome: Solution consistently produces accreditation-ready artifacts suitable for review and downstream eMASS import preparation.
